_comment_LLM: Primary AI provider (Presidio LLM Gateway, a LiteLLM Proxy exposing an Anthropic-compatible pass-through). LLM:BaseUrl and LLM:ApiKey must live in .NET user secrets (dotnet user-secrets set "LLM:BaseUrl" "..." / "LLM:ApiKey" "..."), never in this file. LLM:Model is optional — defaults to claude-sonnet-4-6 if unset.
_comment_Gemini: ROLLBACK ONLY — kept intentionally until the LLM Gateway migration is fully verified. Nothing in the app reads Gemini:ApiKey/ApiUrl anymore; AgentService and CoachGeminiClient both now read LLM:* above. Gemini:PromptFilePath is still read (it's just the local prompt-template path, unrelated to which provider serves the request).
_comment_Coach: AI Learning Coach. All optional — every key below has a working default, and NONE of them is a secret. The coach calls the LLM:* provider above (LLM:ApiKey must live in .NET user secrets, never in this file). With no key/base URL configured the coach returns a friendly 503 and the rest of ExamHub is unaffected.
